thread:
alex: :rotating_light: Pager — canary rollout v3.1 showing sustained p95 latency > 2s and a spike in 5xx on /generate. Auto-rollback didn't fire. Paging oncall.

oncall-bot: Incident INC-7890 created · Sev P1 · assigned to @meera · notify: #incidents #oncall · runbook: rollback_playbook_v2

meera: grabbing it. any idea why auto-rollback skipped?

alex: looks like a semaphore prevented the rollback job from running — release pipeline set `rollback_lock=true` during the DB migration and didn't clear. flag kill-switch exists: `feature.rollout_v3` but UI shows semaphore locked.

jay: i'm on infra, can try to release the semaphore. Confirming the node that set it...

ops-bot: API request queued to release semaphore `rollback_lock`. call-id=ops-4821

jay: releasing now — running: `curl -XPOST "https://ops.internal/api/v1/semaphore/release" -d '{"name":"rollback_lock"}' -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED"`

ops-bot: semaphore `rollback_lock` released successfully (call-id=ops-4821) :white_check_mark:

meera: flipping kill-switch and draining canary pool. commands:
```
redwoodctl feature set rollout_v3 false --env=prod
redwoodctl drain canary --pool=eu-canary --timeout=120
kubectl -n inference rollout undo deploy/model-server --to-revision=42
```

sre-lead: good. after drain, run these quick checks:
- curl health endpoints: `curl -sS https://api.prod/redwood/health | jq .`
- sample generate: `curl -sS -XPOST https://api.prod/redwood/generate -d '{"prompt":"smoke"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer x'`
- check metrics: errors < 0.5% and p95 < 500ms for /generate

meera: running smoke tests now. live sample: latency ~240ms for one request, errors dropping. health shows all services "ok" except a short spike in model-cache which is resolved.

pm-ana: any confirmed customer impact? CS reported 2 timeouts from a single customer (acme-inc) about 12:14 UTC. they opened ticket CS-1123.

alex: noted — escalate to account team, ask for logs and timeframe.

jay: metrics from Grafana: 5xx rate peaked 0.9% at 12:10, now 0.18%. token generation throughput back to normal. routing adjusted back to main pool at 12:22.

oncall-bot: Incident INC-7890 status updated -> mitigated. responder: meera · timeline attached.

meera: monitoring for a 20m verification window. will validate against canary and global SLOs. If stable, we will close and follow postmortem.

sre-lead: action items for postmortem: 1) ensure semaphore auto-clear on pipeline completion; 2) add secondary auto-rollback trigger that ignores semaphore for P1 SLO breaches; 3) add alert for semaphore stuck > 5m.

pm-ana: I will notify CS + Account that we mitigated and we are investigating root cause.

meera: if no regressions in 20m I'll close. leaving a short checklist: 1) confirm error rate < 0.3% for 30m, 2) confirm no customer retries in CS-1123, 3) postmortem draft assigned to alex.

alex: ack. starting postmortem draft now. thanks team. :handshake:

meera: closing note: semaphore release was the unblock. manual rollback sequence completed and smoke tests green. continuing 20m watch. :white_check_mark:
